"Create an ultra-modern, highly animated 3D adventure action game called \"LEGEND OF THE SHADOW WORLD\".

The game should have stunning AAA-quality graphics, realistic 3D environments, smooth character animations, cinematic visual effects, and immersive gameplay.

🎮 GAME FEATURES

- Beautiful 3D open-world environment.
- Realistic animated player character.
- Smooth running, jumping, sliding and climbing animations.
- Dynamic day and night cycle.
- Realistic weather effects, rain, fog and thunderstorms.
- Beautiful forests, mountains, futuristic cities and mysterious caves.
- Intelligent AI enemies and challenging boss levels.
- Collectible coins, gems, rewards and power-ups.
- Multiple missions and progressively harder levels.
- Exciting background music and realistic sound effects.

⚡ SPECIAL POWERS

- Super speed.
- Double jump.
- Energy shield.
- Magical lightning powers.
- Temporary invisibility.
- Special transformation animations.

🕹️ CONTROLS

- Keyboard controls for PC.
- Touchscreen joystick for mobile.
- Jump, attack, slide and special power buttons.
- Smooth camera movement.
- Responsive controls with no input lag.

🎨 GRAPHICS @COMMENT_BODY@ ANIMATIONS

- High-quality 3D models.
- Beautiful lighting and shadows.
- Particle effects and cinematic explosions.
- Smooth 60 FPS target.
- Advanced character movements.
- Stunning game intro and loading screen.
- Professional game menu with animated buttons.

🏆 GAME UI

- Main Menu.
- Play Game.
- Level Selection.
- Settings.
- Sound Controls.
- Pause and Resume.
- Health Bar.
- Score Counter.
- Coin Counter.
- Victory and Game Over screens.

💎 FINAL REQUIREMENTS

Make the game fully playable, not just a visual demo.
All buttons and controls must work.
Include complete gameplay mechanics, collision detection, enemy AI, scoring, and level progression.
Optimize the game for both Android mobile browsers and desktop browsers.
Use Three.js or another suitable 3D game engine.
Create a polished, professional gaming experience with spectacular animations and immersive gameplay.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, playable 3D action-adventure browser game titled **“LEGEND OF THE SHADOW WORLD.”**

## Requirements
- AAA-inspired 3D environments, animations, effects, and immersive gameplay.
- Playable mechanics, enemy AI, boss fights, collectibles, collisions, scoring, and level progression.
- Main menu, level selection, settings, pause/resume, HUD, victory, and game-over screens.
- Keyboard and mobile controls, including double jump, dash, shield, lightning, slide, attack, and joystick movement.
- Desktop and Android browser support with responsive layout and Three.js.

## Decisions
- Used plain Three.js with generated low-poly geometry rather than external 3D assets.
- Implemented three thematic chapters: Grove, Citadel, and Ashen Crown.
- Added localStorage-based chapter unlocking.
- Added a visual fallback menu with animated 3D world rendering behind it.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full HTML application shell and animated professional menu UI.
- Built responsive CSS for desktop and mobile layouts.
- Implemented Three.js scene setup, environment rendering, lighting, fog, particles, shadows, and cameras.
- Added three procedurally styled worlds.
- Added player character rigging, movement, run/jump/double-jump, dash, shield, lightning, slide, and attack animations.
- Added enemies, boss AI, health, collision damage, obstacle collisions, shard collection, score, and objectives.
- Added level selection, settings, sound controls, pause/resume, victory/game-over flows, and chapter unlocking.
- Added mobile joystick and touch action controls.
- Added keyboard controls.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002.
- Installed Chromium for browser testing.

### Active
- Browser visual verification was initiated but the final screenshot step was not completed.
- Console reported only a favicon 404; no application JavaScript console error was reported.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with the installed Playwright Chromium browser.
2. Capture a viewport JPEG screenshot and visually inspect the menu and 3D canvas.
3. Test Play, Level Selection, Settings, pause/resume, movement, combat, and chapter progression.
4. Fix any runtime or visual defects found during testing.
5. Confirm mobile viewport behavior and touch controls.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main game markup and UI structure.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Complete visual system, menus, HUD, and responsive/mobile styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Three.js rendering, gameplay, AI, controls, progression, and effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: Project start script.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`: Screenshot automation entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is self-contained and uses CDN-hosted Three.js and Google Fonts.
- Browser testing requires `http://localhost:3002` and Chromium, now installed.
- The project currently has untracked source files and no committed changes; Git status includes `index.html`, `style.css`, `game.js`, and supporting scripts.
- Final boss chapter progression remains dependent on reaching the gate and defeating the boss logic.

- Build a complete, polished, playable 3D action-adventure browser game titled **“LEGEND OF THE SHADOW WORLD.”**

- Deliver immersive 3D gameplay with enemies, boss fights, collectibles, collisions, scoring, and chapter progression.
